status_authority: GitHub issue state after publication; local statuses are audit-time snapshots

packages.title: Pin the comparison baseline and qualify existing capabilities
packages.scope: Publish a source-hashed capability baseline; preserve Verilator 5.020 as a legacy reference and add a separately pinned 5.052 reference environment. Qualify the current associative slice before extending it; reconcile stale capability descriptions.
tasks: Record exporter, generated model, frontend, compiler and reference versions/hashes; label worktree-only capabilities.
Replay existing associative/queue cases against each pinned reference and an independent oracle; retain disagreements as minimized cases.
Run relevant regressions, native sanitizer/coverage and Stryker.NET/property checks for the associative/frontend changes; report survivors and excluded scopes.
Make README/roadmap point to the authoritative current matrix and preserve historical reports.
packages.acceptance: A reproducible baseline report names every tested source hash, distinct pass/fail/skip counts, line/branch scope and known oracle differences. No broad requirement is closed from focused passes.
packages.evidence: docs/associative-arrays.md; native/rtl/runtime.h; current focused run 14/14 managed and 1/1 native (historical to this audit).

packages.title: Implement the timed scheduler and region semantics
packages.scope: Add an executing HDL scheduler rather than extending the opaque-ID transport claim. Define time precision, active/inactive/NBA ordering, reactivation and explicit supported region boundaries.
tasks: Specify time-unit conversion, overflow, zero-delay ordering and active/inactive/NBA fixpoint behavior.
Implement copyable process/event state using standard containers, sampled NBA payloads/addresses and deterministic ordering only where the language permits.
Integrate model time jumps, pending-event queries, quiescence, budgets and full failure rollback.
Add independent region-order tests, same-source timing comparisons and rejected/out-of-scope region diagnostics.
packages.acceptance: Directed traces cover #0 before NBA, NBA reactivation, simultaneous clocks, sampled delayed addresses, overflow, exhausted budgets and rollback. Host input changes at a future tick cannot leak into earlier queued events.
packages.evidence: native/rtl/timed_events.h transports IDs only; Model::timeInc advances host time without HDL suspension.
packages.implementation_progress: Bounded explicit-time SDK slice implemented; see docs/timed-execution.md. Same-source timing08 10/10 passes; full package acceptance remains open.

packages.title: Lower suspended HDL processes, delays, waits and fork control
packages.scope: Connect typed UHDM/IR suspension points to the scheduler: procedural and intra-assignment delays, event expressions, wait, internal clocks, named events and fork/join families.
tasks: Add explicit resumable process frames and typed delay/event/wait IR nodes; retain original source locations.
Support multiple timed initial/always processes, timeunits/timeprecision and internal generated clocks.
Implement fork/join, join_any/join_none, wait fork and disable fork incrementally with stated process-lifetime rules.
Reject unsupported timing/net-delay forms explicitly; preserve model state and pending events on failure.
packages.acceptance: Same-original-file comparisons exercise producer/consumer handshakes, internal oscillators, delay quantization, wait rearming, nested suspension and fork cancellation; minimized ordering cases have independent expected traces.
packages.evidence: rtl_flatten.h input_events requires direct scalar top-input edges; rtl.cpp statement lowering has no resumable delay/wait cases.
packages.implementation_progress: Bounded explicit-time SDK slice implemented; see docs/timed-execution.md. Same-source timing08 10/10 passes; full package acceptance remains open.

packages.title: Support interacting processes, combinational settling and latches
packages.scope: Move beyond isolated blocking writers and an acyclic whole-word DAG, retaining a documented race policy. Support concurrent startup, legal latch storage, level sensitivity and change-driven reactivation.
tasks: Specify blocking visibility/NBA interactions and diagnose actual races without rejecting all cross-process communication.
Implement multiple initial processes and always_comb startup/sensitivity under the scheduler.
Add always @*, arbitrary level sensitivity, always_latch and selected/array combinational writes.
Support bounded settle-to-quiescence with feedback/nonconvergence diagnostics and source attribution.
packages.acceptance: Interacting RTL examples match independent expectations and applicable references; nonconverging/racy examples are diagnosed without claiming a unique IEEE-required ordering.
packages.evidence: RtlCombinational.SortCombinational rejects feedback/clock dependencies; ValidateCombFlow requires whole-word fully assigned destinations; initializer frontend permits one initial block.
packages.implementation_progress: Bounded explicit-time SDK slice implemented; see docs/timed-execution.md. Same-source timing08 10/10 passes; full package acceptance remains open.

packages.title: Expand functions and tasks beyond pure zero-time inlining
packages.scope: Add stateful/static and timed tasks, broader argument modes and runtime control flow without losing declared conversion or lifetime semantics.
tasks: Support runtime-dependent loops, break/continue and selected/local aggregate writes within functions.
Add named/default arguments, inout/ref/const-ref, arrays/aggregates and nested task calls with alias rules.
Implement static storage, captured globals, hierarchical calls and bounded recursion with explicit frame lifetimes.
Connect timed task calls to suspended processes; remove the combined-output 128-bit restriction only with ABI/copy-out evidence.
packages.acceptance: Tests distinguish pass-by-value from ref aliasing, automatic from static lifetime, early return and recursive limits; timed calls resume correctly and existing pure-call cases stay compatible.
packages.evidence: rtl_subroutines.h requires automatic calls, rejects nested task calls/ref formals and runtime-dependent function trip counts, caps combined task outputs at128 bits.

packages.title: Complete elaboration namespaces, hierarchy and interface connections
packages.scope: Preserve Surelog/UHDM as the elaborator; expand execution lowering for packages/imports, parameter expressions, interfaces/modports and richer hierarchy/ports.
tasks: Audit package/type/value namespaces, instance arrays, nested generate scopes and hierarchical variable/function/task references by declaration identity.
Support compound constant expressions, parameter selections and type parameters without trusting lossy folded values.
Add legal open ports, selected/aggregate/unpacked ports, inout binding and interfaces/modports.
Evaluate bind/program/clocking/virtual-interface forms individually; explicitly diagnose unsupported cases and add multi-file include/macro tests.
packages.acceptance: Multi-file same-source designs preserve shadowing, distinct parameter overrides, generated scope names and port conversion; supported parsing alone never counts as executable capability.
packages.evidence: rtl_flatten.h rejects open/unresolved, inout and memory instance ports; parameter capture contract only accepts known literal/unary-literal values.

packages.title: Broaden expressions, numeric types and packed word sizes
packages.scope: Remove the fixed 256-bit boundary deliberately and add missing typed expression families; treat real arithmetic as a separate numeric model rather than an integer approximation.
tasks: Inventory unsupported casts, fill literals, streaming concatenation, assignment expressions, wildcard equality/inside and system bit/count queries.
Implement flexible packed declaration bounds, signed indices/conversions and words beyond256 bits with matched host/VPI representation.
Add real/shortreal, string and handle type contracts or explicit scoped rejections; define numerical conversion/rounding.
Reconcile legacy64-bit independent IR with structural RTL capabilities without implying they already share a representation.
packages.acceptance: Independent BigInteger/bit-string oracles and multiple frontends cover widths255/256/257/512/1024, X/Z, signed overflow and casts; ABI changes are versioned and old hosts fail clearly.
packages.evidence: RTL validation/runtime cap words256; independent IR remains64-bit. Existing byte/shortint/int/longint/integer/time and bounded enums are implemented.

packages.title: Expand aggregates, array shapes and whole-array operations
packages.scope: Add unpacked/mixed-state aggregates, assignment patterns and array operations beyond bounded scalar elements.
tasks: Define unpacked structures/unions, tagged forms and aggregate layout/state conversion; retain explicit diagnostics for unsupported forms.
Support whole-array assignments, slices, foreach and aggregate argument/port transport.
Extend negative/unusual dimension bounds, rank limits, shape conversions and packed multidimensional declarations.
Add aggregate/container nesting and alias/copy semantics using typed storage rather than flattening away lifetime.
packages.acceptance: Tests verify member layout independently, array direction/bounds, deep-copy behavior and malformed shape rejection; resource limits become explicit configurable contracts.
packages.evidence: Current packed aggregates require uniform state, untagged equal-width unions; fixed arrays rank1..4, nonnegative bounds, total256 cells.

packages.title: Finish dynamic, associative and queue language semantics
packages.scope: Extend the existing working bounded container slices rather than reimplementing storage. Close language-level method, lifetime, copy and ownership gaps.
tasks: Add string/wildcard associative keys, foreach, nested values, default patterns and broader key/value types.
Add dynamic-array cross-array initialization/copy, nested dimensions and lifetime-safe references.
Add queue insert, slices/$ indexing, bounded queue declarations/truncation, concatenation and array methods.
Implement locator/order/reduction methods and configurable capacity; qualify signed/absent-key/missing-read behavior independently of the legacy reference.
packages.acceptance: Each method has typed same-source positive/negative cases, independent container expectations, overflow atomicity and rollback; no test exclusion is mislabeled as Verilator agreement.
packages.evidence: Current integral associative worktree slice passes focused14+native1; queues/dynamic arrays remain module-scope1D and capped256.

packages.title: Implement HDL system tasks, strings, real values and file I/O
packages.scope: Make ordinary self-checking testbenches usable: diagnostics, termination, time queries, plusargs, memory files, formatted text and reproducible random functions.
tasks: Implement $display/$write/$strobe/$monitor, $finish/$stop/$fatal/$error with correct execution region and exit results.
Add $time/$realtime and timescale formatting; string operations and numeric formatting/conversion.
Add plusargs and $readmemh/$readmemb plus file open/read/write/scan with checked failures and deterministic paths.
Provide seeded $random/$urandom families with documented state scope and replay metadata.
packages.acceptance: Self-checking HDL programs execute and fail with exact status/source diagnostics; file malformed/missing/error cases and time-format rounding are tested independently.
packages.evidence: rtl.cpp accepts only a narrow system-function whitelist and has no general system-task runtime; host trace printing is not HDL $display support.

packages.title: Add resolved nets, inouts, primitives and force/release
packages.scope: Specify four-state multi-driver resolution and expand wire/inout/gate semantics. Separate useful digital parity from analog or full timing-check ambitions.
tasks: Add multi-driver wire/tri/wand/wor/supply/pull resolution and bidirectional port behavior.
Lower digital gate primitives and UDP tables with checked source semantics.
Implement force/release lifetime, deposits and delayed continuous/net assignments as separately accepted slices.
Record strengths, transistor switches, specify/SDF and analog modeling as scoped decisions rather than assuming Verilator provides full conformance.
packages.acceptance: Independent resolution tables exercise Z, conflicting drivers, force/release and hierarchy; do not use mostly-two-state Verilator as the sole resolution oracle.
packages.evidence: rtl_flatten.h rejects resolved/pull net types and inout ports; continuous assignment delays/strengths explicitly rejected.

packages.title: Provide SystemVerilog DPI-C import and export
packages.scope: Add actual HDL import/export DPI-C functionality; a similarly named generated C++ class is not DPI compatibility.
tasks: Specify standard scalar/vector/4-state argument ABI and generate svdpi-compatible declarations.
Implement import/export functions/tasks, context scope and error propagation across the native boundary.
Add open-array handles, strings and ref/output modes incrementally with lifetime tests.
Create standalone external-host examples and ABI compatibility tests on Windows/Linux.
packages.acceptance: The same small C host and HDL DPI fixtures compile against both tools for the declared subset, exercise imports and exports, and reject unsupported signatures clearly.
packages.evidence: Current SDK exposes V<top> lifecycle/ports and a VPI subset; no implemented DPI import/export lowering found.

packages.title: Expand VPI scheduling, hierarchy and cocotb integration
packages.scope: Broaden the existing VPI subset based on required client behavior; retain checked ABI and honest supported-call documentation.
tasks: Add simulator time units/precision, nested scopes, indexed memory/aggregate handles and standard value formats.
Implement timed/read-write/read-only/next-time callbacks and cancellation at correct scheduler regions.
Add delayed puts and force/release modes only when their semantics are implemented; preserve multi-model isolation.
Qualify cocotb/GPI compatibility against real client tests, treating third-party Python as an explicit integration dependency.
packages.acceptance: A documented API capability table links each supported operation to tests, including callback ordering, reentrancy, removed handles, multiple models and actual cocotb smoke/regressions.
packages.evidence: vpi_user.h currently defines ValueChange, ReadOnlySynch, StartOfSimulation and EndOfSimulation; a full header does not supply missing runtime services.

packages.title: Implement assertions, properties and sampled-value semantics
packages.scope: Add explicit immediate/assertion support and a staged SVA subset with sampling regions, failure reporting and coverage. Reject unsupported property forms.
tasks: Fail closed on executable assertions currently outside the IR; add immediate assertions with source diagnostics.
Specify sampled values, $past/$rose/$fell/$stable and clock/disable-iff handling.
Implement bounded concurrent sequences/implication/repetition and cover property incrementally.
Track unsupported liveness/sequence forms and compare failure cycles with independent monitors and pinned Verilator.
packages.acceptance: Intentionally failing properties demonstrably fail at the expected cycle; no successful build may silently erase verification statements. SVA support remains a declared subset.
packages.evidence: Current audit probe: concurrent assert property accepted by Surelog and exporter (exit0); emitted normalized model has no assertion/property node. This is source/IR evidence of omission, not a new runtime simulation.

packages.title: Collect coverage of simulated HDL designs
packages.scope: Add DUT line/branch/toggle/property/functional coverage. Keep it separate from Coverlet/LLVM measurement of simulator implementation.
tasks: Preserve HDL source maps through elaboration, flattening and generated code.
Instrument HDL line/branch/toggle counters and emit stable mergeable IDs.
Add property counters and a staged covergroup/coverpoint/bin/cross subset.
Provide merge/report/exclusion APIs and verify counts with hand-calculated HDL fixtures.
packages.acceptance: A tiny DUT produces independently predicted counts across merged runs; reports identify excluded constructs, reset semantics and source hashes. Simulator C# coverage is never reported as DUT coverage.
packages.evidence: Existing Coverlet/LLVM and qualification reports measure simulator source; no established general HDL coverage product was found.

packages.title: Plan staged classes, constrained randomization and UVM support
packages.scope: A separate testbench-language milestone after RTL correctness, not a promise of immediate UVM parity. Define object lifetimes, synchronization and constraint-solving integration.
tasks: Inventory object handles, inheritance/virtual dispatch, constructors and visibility before selecting representation.
Add class methods, mailboxes/semaphores and supported virtual-interface/clocking behavior in coherent slices.
Research maintained solver/library integration for constraints and seeded random stability; retain unsatisfied-constraint diagnostics.
Pin a UVM release and run explicit compatibility tests only after prerequisites; document known limitations.
Implement VS-RANDOM-CONSTRAINT-001 in documented subsets; evaluate Z3 as an informational candidate and independently verify translation, replay and solver failures.
packages.acceptance: Each staged subset has reproducible tests and a compatibility manifest. Do not label parse acceptance or a toy class example as UVM support.
packages.evidence: Current RTL types/lowering only support bounded word/array storage; official Verilator5.052 release announces UVM2020-3.2 with limitations, unlike installed5.020.

packages.title: Add HDL tracing, source debugging and model checkpoints
packages.scope: Provide hierarchical waveforms, usable runtime diagnostics and persistent model save/restore; distinguish test trace strings and exception rollback from these user features.
tasks: Implement VS-TRACE-COMPRESSED-001 lossless compressed waveforms; evaluate FST/libfst (LIB-11) as implementation information; preserve hierarchy, wide X/Z values and simulation time.
Implement time/source/process context in runtime failures and controlled trace filtering.
Specify portable/versioned checkpoint schema for words, containers, scheduler frames and events.
Qualify save/restore, multi-model context and ABI mismatch failures; assess SystemC adapter needs with WP-19.
packages.acceptance: Waveforms parsed by an independent reader match known traces; checkpoint restart reproduces future outputs/events exactly and rejects mismatched source/runtime versions. Compressed waveform output must satisfy VS-TRACE-COMPRESSED-001; plain text or VCD-only output does not close that requirement.
packages.evidence: VS_RTL text output supports comparison; SDK rollback is in-memory exception recovery, not a complete waveform/checkpoint product.

packages.title: Scale simulation, resource limits and measured parallel execution
packages.scope: Remove toy-design bottlenecks and measure the actual structural backend. Worker-count configuration and a parallel native kernel do not prove HDL execution speedup.
tasks: Make signal/memory/process/depth/step budgets explicit configurable limits with predictable rejection.
Profile representative CPU/bus/FIFO designs and separate elaboration, generation, native compile and simulation timing.
Add reusable incremental code-generation/build caching and split output where measurements justify it.
Parallelize independent structural work only after semantic dependency analysis; compare outputs and wall/CPU/memory on identical sources.
packages.acceptance: Published benchmarks include source/tool/configuration hashes, baseline timings, repeat distributions and correctness checks; demonstrate actual worker scaling or explicitly report no gain.
packages.evidence: rtl_flatten.h declaration budgets256 signals/16 memories, process and expansion limits; generated multi-worker comparisons alone are not speedup evidence.

packages.title: Qualify Windows/Linux distribution and native host integrations
packages.scope: Make clean-machine installs, SDK generation and hosts reproducible on intended platforms; assess SystemC as a separate supported integration.
tasks: Validate portable checked download/setup flows, pinned SDKs/tools and resumable authentication without overwriting checkouts.
Run native Windows and Linux exported-host/plugin smoke cases with distinct output trees and ABI manifests.
Add SystemC scheduling adapter only against an explicit tested integration contract.
Package examples, API XMLDoc/engineering docs and offline handoff instructions; preserve manual/disabled CI policies.
packages.acceptance: A disconnected Windows machine can follow the documented flow and reproduce a short verified run before long campaigns; native-vs-WSL coverage and unsupported toolchains are explicit.
packages.evidence: Remote campaign tooling and NativeAOT tooling exist; this audit does not rerun clean-machine Windows installation or certify SystemC compatibility.

packages.title: Reject executable constructs that lowering would silently omit
packages.scope: Audit UHDM module/scope items and prevent successful compilation from discarding executable behavior such as assertions, final blocks, primitives or unsupported processes.
tasks: Inventory every executable/module-item UHDM family and classify lowered, elaboration-only, explicitly ignored by contract, or rejected.
Add source-located diagnostics for unknown executable items and preserve recognized inactive/elaboration-only declarations.
Add negative fixtures for assertions, final blocks, gate/UDP instances, bind/clocking/program items and unsupported statements.
Require an intentionally observable behavior/failure test for every accepted executable feature, including verification statements.
packages.acceptance: Unsupported executable constructs fail explicitly; supported assertions and final blocks have demonstrable effects. A positive parser/exporter exit alone never satisfies acceptance.
packages.evidence: Current audit probe: concurrent assert property accepted by Surelog and exporter (exit0); emitted normalized model has no assertion/property node. This is source/IR evidence of omission, not a new runtime simulation.

capabilities.gap: Top scalar input posedge/negedge and async-reset edge lists work; internal/arbitrary events do not.
Blocking writes are isolated; general interprocess blocking visibility and races are rejected.
Opaque-ID transport exists; no suspended-HDL execution scheduler.
No typed resumable delay execution; transport availability is not HDL support.

capabilities.feature: Event expressions, wait and named events
capabilities.gap: Only direct scalar top-input edge events are lowered.
No resumable fork process/frame IR.

capabilities.feature: Time units/precision and HDL time queries
capabilities.gap: Host uint64 time exists; HDL timescale/scheduler semantics remain open.
Ordered constant declaration startup plus at most one untimed initial; final execution not established.
Acyclic fully assigned whole-word DAG implemented; feedback/clock-dependent logic and broader sensitivity remain restricted.
Explicit input-edge processes and bounded always_comb only.
while/do/repeat/for implemented under shared20000-step budget; break/continue/foreach/general suspension absent.
Typed nonrecursive inlining, explicit returns and bounded constant-control loops exist; runtime function loops/captures limited.
Pure zero-time input/output task inlining; no ref/inout/nested tasks, selected copy-out or general timed tasks; combined outputs128 bits.

capabilities.feature: Static lifetime, recursion and global captures
capabilities.gap: Only automatic pure bounded calls; mutable captures/static state/hierarchical calls unsupported.
Elaborated module/generate flattening exists; depth/declaration/port restrictions remain.

capabilities.feature: Open, selected, unpacked and inout ports
capabilities.gap: Scalar-word inputs/whole-word outputs accepted; open and memory instance ports rejected.
Elaboration parsing does not establish typed runtime lowering; no general interface execution contract.
Literal/unary-literal immutable captures are bound by declaration; compound constants/selections/types need explicit audit.
Surelog include directories/defines/multiple sources are wired; broad macro/library configuration qualification is not established.
RTL words1..256 and byte/shortint/int/longint/integer/time/enums exist; no blanket Verilog type-conformance claim.
Structural model and ABI2 cap256; separate independent IR cap64.

capabilities.feature: Packed declaration bounds and signed indices
capabilities.gap: Canonical descending packed bounds and unsigned fixed-array/selection index restrictions remain.

capabilities.feature: Broader operators, casts and fill literals
capabilities.gap: Many arithmetic/logic/selected-write operators exist; no general streaming/pattern/inside/cast expression lowering.
Packed integral storage cannot represent general real/string/object lifetime semantics.
Uniform-state packed structures/equal-width untagged unions supported to256 bits; enum forms bounded.
These aggregate forms are explicitly outside the packed contract.
Rank1..4, nonnegative bounds and total256 elements; broader shapes/ranks remain open.
Current IR addresses scalar elements; broad aggregate copies/patterns/iteration not supplied.
Owning1D new[count]/self-preserving resize,size,delete,indexed operations exist; cross-array/nested/aggregate forms absent.
push/pop/size/delete/indexed operations bounded256; insert/slices/$/bounded-queue behavior and wider methods open.
Map-backed integral1..256-bit keys, num/exists/delete/traversal, focused14managed+1native; broader regression/qualification still open.
Current associative type metadata accepts integral keys only, module-scope packed values.
No general find/sort/reverse/sum/product method family in emitted IR.

capabilities.feature: Container references, copies and process sharing
capabilities.gap: Owning snapshots/rollback exist; mutation isolation rejects general cross-process container readers and alias references.

capabilities.feature: HDL print, fatal and termination tasks
capabilities.gap: Generated harness tracing is not HDL $display/$fatal/$finish execution support.

capabilities.feature: Memory-file load and general file I/O
capabilities.gap: No general $readmemh/$readmemb or fopen/scan/format runtime lowering.

capabilities.feature: Plusargs and seeded HDL random functions
capabilities.gap: Test-runner seeds exist; HDL plusargs/random function semantics are separate and absent.
Only narrow system-function handling; broad $bits/$countones/$isunknown queries need lowering/qualification.
Resolved/pull net types and inout connections rejected; four-state words alone do not resolve drivers.
No established executable gate/UDP lowering contract; audit for silent omission before implementing.
No force/release runtime; continuous delays/strengths explicitly rejected.
V<top> ports/eval/final/host time and ABI2 exist; API resemblance does not guarantee Verilator source compatibility.
No HDL DPI-C implementation; external C++ port access and VPI are distinct.

capabilities.feature: VPI basic handles, deposits and callbacks
capabilities.gap: Implemented limited VPI subset against same model state; not full standard API.

capabilities.feature: VPI timed callbacks, memory handles and force
capabilities.gap: Limited callback reasons and word handles; complete scheduler/client semantics absent.
No current full-client qualification; a compatible-looking header is insufficient.
Audit probe accepts assert property (exporter exit0) but emits no assertion/property node. Unsupported verification behavior is silently omitted.
Coverlet/LLVM measure simulator code; no general emitted HDL coverage counters/report product.
No coverpoint/bin/cross model or source-level coverage integration.
No object heap/lifetime/dispatch/mailbox/semaphore runtime model.
No class constraint solver/UVM execution contract; keep a later milestone.
Text comparison traces exist; a general structural HDL waveform product is not established.
Exception rollback is not persistent complete-model checkpoint/restart.
Rejection/resource diagnostics exist; hierarchy/time/process source mapping and interactive workflow incomplete.
256signal/16memory declarations, bounded depth/steps/containers; no representative large-design acceptance baseline.
Worker1/4/8 equal-output checks are not evidence of structural process parallel speedup; native kernels have separate scopes.
NativeAOT/exported SDK/remote scripts exist; this audit does not certify clean-machine platform parity.
No current generated SystemC adapter conformance evidence.
Confirmed assertion omission in the frontend probe; audit other executable module items and fail explicitly.
Historical docs describe64/128-bit and earlier single-process limits; worktree associative changes are not in HEAD or remote.

C.title: C++/SystemC, DPI, VPI and host timing APIs

X.title: Verilation, tracing, hierarchy, threads and CMake

library_review.evidence: source and primary-documentation review; no new dependency builds or runtime results
